title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
summary: F5 released emergency security updates to fix five critical flaws in its BIG-IP networking software. Attackers can exploit these vulnerabilities to crash systems or take complete remote control of them.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses F5 BIG-IP systems, your IT team should handle the updates.
action_it: Apply F5's emergency patches immediately to address the critical vulnerabilities.

title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
summary: Hackers are actively exploiting a critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway devices to break into company networks. This matters because it allows remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to internal systems.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses Cisco Expressway, your IT team should already be on it.
action_it: Apply the available security updates for CVE-2026-76466 immediately and monitor your network logs for signs of unauthorized access.

title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
summary: Hackers have been actively exploiting a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server since September. The vulnerability allows attackers to bypass login security and gain administrator access to steal data.

also_covered.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data

action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses VMware vCenter, your IT team should already be on it.
action_it: Apply Broadcom's security updates for VMware vCenter Server immediately to fix the authentication bypass flaw.

title: ASUS warns of critical hard-coded key flaw in Control Center Express
summary: ASUS fixed three critical security flaws in its Control Center Express software that could let attackers take complete control of management consoles and connected devices. Users should update to version 1.7.29 immediately.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses ASUS Control Center Express, your IT team should already be on it.
action_it: Apply the update to ASUS Control Center Express version 1.7.29 immediately to fix the three critical vulnerabilities.

title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
summary: A security flaw in Linux allows virtual machines to peek into the memory of the main host server on certain systems. This could potentially let attackers on cloud services see data belonging to other customers.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If you use cloud servers, your hosting provider or IT team will need to apply the available updates.
action_it: Apply the updated Linux kernel packages that contain the fix for CVE-2026-99312, particularly on hosts utilizing AMD processors with nested virtualization enabled.

title: SonicWall Warns Gen 6 Firewalls Won't Get Security Patches, Even for Critical Flaws
summary: SonicWall is warning customers that older Gen 6 firewalls will no longer receive security patches, even for critical flaws. This matters because unsupported devices left connected to the internet are at high risk of being targeted by automated and AI-driven attacks.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything. If your workplace uses SonicWall Gen 6 firewalls, your IT team should already be aware of this warning and plan to replace the hardware.
action_it: Retire and replace Gen 6 firewalls immediately, and ensure these unsupported devices are no longer exposed on the internet edge.

title: ROMULUS ClickFix Attacks Deliver RAT That Can Spy on Users and Control PCs
summary: Hackers are using fake error messages on websites to trick people into downloading a dangerous remote-control program. This lets criminals spy on users and take over their computers.
action_everyone: Be very careful if a website suddenly pops up telling you there is an error and instructing you to copy and paste text or run a command to fix it. Most people should just close the page and ignore the warning.
action_it: Monitor endpoints and network traffic for unusual binary sideloading activity and unauthorized remote access tools associated with the ROMULUS and CNCMachineRMS campaigns.

title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
summary: A newly discovered technique called FastUnlock lets a person with physical access to a locked Windows computer run programs without logging in. While it only grants a limited user account instead of full control, there is no official fix available yet.
action_everyone: Most people don't need to do anything right away, but you should never leave your Windows computer unattended in a public place. There is no official software update to fix this yet.
action_it: Since no official patch is currently available, monitor physical access to workstations and endpoint security logs for unauthorized program execution from locked screens.

title: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info
summary: J.P. Morgan Chase experienced a data breach after a third-party service provider was hacked. The incident exposed customers' personal information and marketing data.

title: N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage
summary: N-able suffered a security breach on one of its servers, causing a major worldwide outage for its Mail Assure and SpamExperts cloud services. This disruption affects email filtering and security services for users globally.

title: Hackers steal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers
summary: Hackers breached SBC Medical Group in two cyberattacks, exposing the personal data of 1.6 million customers and employees. This matters because sensitive private information has been compromised, putting those affected at risk of identity theft or scams.

title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
summary: Using spreadsheets to track company passwords leaves businesses vulnerable to weak or stolen credentials. Centralized password management tools help companies secure and monitor their logins.

title: Microsoft now automatically installs Windows 11 26H2 on unmanaged devices
summary: Microsoft has started automatically upgrading eligible personal computers to Windows 11 version 26H2. This change applies to devices not managed by a company's IT department.

title: The Path to AI Autonomy in the SOC
summary: A survey of top security leaders shows that many plan to give artificial intelligence systems independent authority to handle security tasks over the next year. This matters because it marks a major shift toward automated decision-making in protecting corporate networks.

title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
summary: Microsoft has released a preview update for Windows 11 that includes 28 changes and bug fixes. This update is optional and lets users test new features before they become permanent.
